learning.conditions: Free, self-paced HP LIFE course co-developed with UNIDO. A free HP LIFE learner account is needed to track completion and access the issuer's course completion certificate; it is not professional AI certification.

outcomes.name: HP LIFE Certificate of Completion — AI for Beginners
outcomes.requirements: Sign in with an HP LIFE account, complete the course's learning activities, and obtain the free Certificate of Completion. The course is a short foundational introduction (about 60 minutes), not an independently accredited AI qualification or exam credential.

evidence.short_quote: Learn critical skills free of charge
evidence.review_note: HP LIFE describes its online courses as free, with AI among the topics.
Course-specific official page confirms availability of a named completion certificate.

evidence.short_quote: Get a free Certificate of Completion
evidence.review_note: Provider expressly offers free completion certificates for finished courses.

evidence.short_quote: certificate of completion for every course you finish
evidence.review_note: Issuer ties the award to completing this course; no paid exam is offered for the ordinary certificate.
